title: Concept: Requirements file that disables binary wheels globally
description: requirements.txt declares a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package.
